candidates.title: A simplified economic model for inertial fusion (PMC open access)
candidates.notes: Full HTML text of Hawker 2020 (Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A, DOI: 10.1098/rsta.2020.0053). Confirmed to contain thermal efficiency parameter: 40% default, range 30–60% explored via Monte Carlo. Notes that Li loop losses are not modeled in detail — author flags this as a limitation. Model uses 14 technology-agnostic parameters.

candidates.title: The heat transport system and plant design for the HYLIFE-2 fusion reactor
candidates.notes: OSTI biblio/6780071. Conference paper (LLNL, 1990). Directly addresses heat transport system and plant design for HYLIFE-2, a liquid-wall IFE concept with FLiBe jets — the closest published analogue to FLF's liquid Li curtain. Abstract mentions scoping study for 'minimum cost of electricity', implying cost data present. Accessible as PDF via OSTI purl.

candidates.title: Electromagnetic pumping of liquid lithium in inertial confinement fusion reactors
candidates.notes: OSTI biblio/6360934. Technical report specifically on EM pump design for liquid Li ICF reactors. Compares annular-linear-induction pump vs. helical-rotor EM pump for HYLIFE requirements (8.08 m³/s flow at 82.5 kPa head). Pump efficiencies: 50% (normal conducting) and 60% (superconducting). Accessible as 3.5 MB PDF via OSTI purl.
